rationale: #743 cpp port (the C wave's rule, narrowed for cpp). A BARE identifier macro in the declaration specifier was MEASURED, through the production entry, to cost the whole decorated declaration AND to mint a phantom symbol named after the macro: on fmt, `define FMT_EXPORT` + `FMT_EXPORT struct as_identifiers_t { ... };` parsed as a declaration whose type was `FMT_EXPORT` with a phantom `namespace_identifier "struct"` and a MISSING `::`, so no `as_identifiers_t` symbol and no members existed; `variable struct`, `variable enum`, `variable class` and `type typedef` were literal keyword-named symbols (8 of them across fmt under the old grammar, 2 under this one). Porting the C rule VERBATIM was refused on measurement: cpp's `_scope_resolution` has an OPTIONAL scope, so `A::B` is readable as the qualified type `A::B` or as macro `A` decorating the type `::B`; that new derivation needed a conflict declaration, and declaring it flipped runtime path selection in unrelated code — `fmt::format_to(std::back_inserter(buf), format_str, item1, item2);`, a statement in a file with zero ERRORs, parsed as a DECLARATION of a function named `::format_to`. The landed rule therefore restricts the decorated type to the KEYWORD-LED specifiers, which makes the bad derivation ungrammatical and needs no conflict at all. This fixture pins both halves: the recovery (classes + owned members) and the non-hijack (`ns::sink(1)` stays a call; a qualified type stays a type). REFINED 2026-09-30 (D9): `EXPORT_API` and `NLOHMANN_DECL` are `#define`d in this very file (lines 20-21), and the pins said no symbol of ANY kind may carry those names. The invariant this file documents is narrower and is stated in its own `forbidSymbols`: the defect is a PHANTOM symbol of kind `variable` minted from specifier recovery. D9 publishes the macro DECLARATION (kind `constant`, from the `preproc_def` node), so the name-scoped pin could not distinguish them. Pins are now kind-scoped to `variable` and a positive pin requires the declaration — stricter than before on both sides. The `struct`/`enum`/`class`/`typedef` counts stay at 0 unscoped: those are keyword fabrications with no legitimate declaration to collide with.
